description: Implementation of the ResolvedTargetData class methods for managing target dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and related build information in a build system.

classes.name: ResolvedTargetData
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and computing dependency and build information for build targets.

methods.name: GetTargetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates TargetInfo for a given target, with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: ComputeLibInfo
methods.description: Computes and populates library directories and files for a target.

methods.name: ComputeFrameworkInfo
methods.description: Computes and populates framework directories and frameworks for a target.

methods.name: ComputeHardDeps
methods.description: Determines and sets the hard dependencies for a target.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibs
methods.description: Calculates inherited libraries for a target based on dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibsFor
methods.description: Helper to compute inherited libraries for specific dependency sets.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformation
methods.description: Computes module dependency information for a target.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformationFor
methods.description: Helper to compute module dependencies for specific dependency sets.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibs
methods.description: Computes Rust library dependencies for a target.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibsFor
methods.description: Helper to compute Rust libraries for specific dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeSwiftValues
methods.description: Computes Swift module and public module dependencies for a target.
